title: Pondbound
tagline: Hop lily pads, dodge the ripples, keep the crown dry.
description: A tiny frog has one afternoon to cross the pond before the wind reverses. Tap a pad, read the ripple rings, and chain clean landings for a shinier crown.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Pondbound. A tiny frog has one afternoon to cross the pond before the wind reverses. Tap a pad, read the ripple rings, and chain clean landings for a shinier crown.
